title: Score-climbing automation loop — benchmark run → failure analysis → versioned prompt proposal → operator approve → re-run
goal: The motor that drives AegisPT from 50% → 80% XBOW score. Automated iteration: after each benchmark run, analyze failed challenges, identify patterns (prompt gap? state-machine gap? tool gap?), generate VERSIONED prompt/state proposals (no runtime self-modify per Codex), operator approves, re-run, compare delta. Permanent improvement infrastructure.
scope: (1) New `scripts/xbow_score_climb.py`: orchestrates iteration cycle. (2) `api/app/services/failure_analysis.py`: cluster failed XBOW challenges by failure-mode using Claude. (3) Proposal generation: writes new prompt/state-machine version to `prompts/proposals/{date}-{component}-rev{N}.md`. (4) Operator approval workflow: CLI command `aegispt promote-proposal {file}` moves proposal → live after operator confirms. (5) Delta-report after each iteration. Per Codex 'no runtime self-modify': all changes versioned + approved.
generation_reason: Per user 2026-05-20: 'Ik verwacht minimaal 80% XBOW score'. Reaching 80% requires sustained iteration, not one-shot prompt-tuning. Per Codex: 'versioned proposals met approval' — no runtime self-modify. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'XBOW score climbed ≥X% per iteration cycle, sustained over ≥3 cycles'.

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Iteration loop + failure analysis + proposal mechanism only.
constraints.versioned_proposals_only: All prompt/state changes written to prompts/proposals/ as PR-style files. Operator must explicitly approve before live deployment. No agent-self-rewrite of production prompts.
constraints.audit_trail: Each iteration cycle logged with before-score, after-score, delta, applied-proposals.

success_criteria: Metric: ≥1 complete iteration cycle executed end-to-end (baseline → analyze → propose → approve → re-run → delta).
Metric: Iteration cycle 1 produces XBOW score delta ≥+5% (e.g. 30% → 35%).
Metric: 0 prompts in production were changed without proposal+approval trail (audit log verified).
Failure clustering identifies ≥3 distinct failure-mode categories.
Cycle telemetry: time-per-iteration, cost-per-iteration, prompts-proposed, prompts-approved, prompts-rejected.
Live: cycle 1 demonstrated; cycles 2+ are operator-on-demand (ongoing program, not single-task DONE).
must_not_touch: Production prompts directly (only via proposal mechanism)

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with cycle 1 evidence + score climb + audit trail + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-420 (queue #372 — Neo4j knowledge graph) into NEXT_TASK.md (parity sprint starts).

out_of_scope: Reaching 80% in this task (continuous program; this delivers cycle 1)
